correctness.rationale: Eliminating z gives the shared endemic state. The Jacobian has trace −(A+κB), determinant κ(τ−1), and scaled discriminant (1−r)²−4rg for r=κ/κ₀; the nonzero off-diagonal entry rules out a scalar matrix at the two discriminant roots. Differentiating κ/(A+κB)² gives the unique damping-ratio optimizer. For the spectral rate, put S=A+κB, T=τ−1 and X=BS−2T; on the node branches X²−B²D=4TC>0, with X negative on the lower branch and positive on the upper branch. Thus the rate increases through the lower node and focus intervals and decreases on the upper one. For the nonlinear claim, at κ₀ the map e^(−Jt) applied to the state deviation is the initial deviation plus a convergent integral of the quadratic remainder. Indeed the normalized integrand is O(ε² exp(−(A−2δ)t)) for any fixed 0<δ<A/2 using local exponential stability with rate A−δ. This directly gives an ε+O(ε²) cosine coefficient. At fixed κ_b>κ₀, the eigenvalues are strictly left of −A (for real roots use the characteristic polynomial's value κ_b C>0 at −A and the sum of roots less than −2A). The faster local solution is o(exp(−At)), also at its Jordan point. Alternating signs at successive sufficiently late cosine extrema prove the exact nonlinear same-initial-state comparison. The RK4 and finite rational checks are supplementary only.
residual_risks: Smallness of ε is local and can depend on κ_b. The spectral exponent at the upper defective threshold is not a pure uniform exponential or a finite-time optimization.

value.rationale: Holding equilibrium burden fixed separates transient behavior from limiting prevalence. The spectral and damping-ratio optima show that two well-defined transient objectives prefer different speeds, and the nonlinear result rules out an eventual permanent prevalence ordering for the specified paired perturbations. Infinitely late but vanishing reversals are more informative here than a plotted spiral or equal endpoints.
residual_risks: A local deterministic mean-field comparison, not a stochastic epidemic claim, policy recommendation, or persistent-cycle result.
